This is really solid work. A lot of z/OS concepts were already present in MVS, and this is one of the few OSs you can run on a mainframe without an IBM license.

Good work. Any number of local tests can be run or just your JCL with TYPERUN=SCAN

bananamogul · Nov 28, 2026

I wish someone would do the work to make MVS 3.8j a proper 32-bit OS.

Admittedly, I have no idea what I would actually do with it.

emersonrsantos · Nov 28, 2026

There's the 31-bit https://mvs380.sourceforge.net/ - not 32-bit because of IBM XA original architecture.

Although the CPU is 32-bit, 31-bit was chosen for compatibility with legacy 24-bit, being the most significant (missing) bit the mode/control flag.

tliltocatl · Nov 28, 2026

AFAIK, there's no MVS sources available (only assembler output by PL/S compiler).
